vibe.verdict: The old tavern look suits the Sanderson sisters and the food is witchy, but the poster sits in a box with black bars.
missing: The sisters singing 'I Put a Spell on You' at the town hall (the party)
Billy Butcherson cutting his stitched mouth open (the road)
The witches trapped in the school kiln (the school)
Max lighting the Black Flame Candle (the cemetery)
The salt barrier around Dani (the cemetery)
Winifred turning to dust at sunrise (the finish)

Swap 'Salem clam chowder' (note: A cold New England Halloween night) for 'Billy's stitched mouth stew'.
Replace 'Apple cider doughnuts' with 'Kiln baked spell biscuits'.
